args.title: Update API documentation for totals endpoint to clarify units
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

The documentation for the `GET /reports/:id/totals` endpoint should specify that the inflow and outflow amounts are represented in cents, which are minor units for currency, and clarify that outflow values may appear as negative numbers.
